name: research-director-desktop-shell
description: Daftar personal agent office: one Donna chat, scoped employee authority, an interactive office blueprint and native execution control.
author: Daftar contributors

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-renderer-assets.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron .
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --linux dir
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir
scripts.package:win: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:renderer: tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-renderer-assets.mjs && node tests/renderer-behavior.mjs
